grf.observed: Current merged resolver rejects duplicate declared package providers before symbol semantics are selected.
grf.generated_hypothesis: Provider provenance multiplicity must remain visible even when two explicit providers are byte/content identical.
grf.counter_reality: A content-addressed resolver could collapse equal package hashes into one provider and silently erase the fact that two explicit provider roots asserted the same package authority.
grf.discriminator: Create two physically distinct provider roots with byte-identical package manifests/content, require equal canonical package hashes, then supply both explicitly to the provider resolver.
grf.collapse: Content identity is not provider provenance. Duplicate explicit package providers must fail closed rather than deduplicate by hash.
